sql_by_query.q_769c8994e929285eac64a45f: SELECT t1.thanh_pho AS "city", SUM(t0.tong_tien) AS "revenue" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DANG_GIAO')) AND (t0.ngay_tao >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.ngay_tao < DATE '2026-10-01') GROUP BY t1.thanh_pho ORDER BY "revenue" ASC NULLS LAST, "city" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

sql_by_query.q_a21ceec82aaf7dcdb5bd4341: WITH scoped_rows AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', t0.ngay_tao) AS period, t1.loai_diem_ban AS "store_type", t1.thanh_pho AS "city", SUM(t0.tong_tien) AS "revenue" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DANG_GIAO')) AND (t0.ngay_tao >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AND (t0.ngay_tao < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', t0.ngay_tao), t1.loai_diem_ban, t1.thanh_pho), ranked_cohort AS (SELECT rc_t1.thanh_pho AS "city", SUM(rc_t0.tong_tien) AS "revenue" FROM silver.don_hang AS rc_t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS rc_t1 ON rc_t0.co_so_ma = rc_t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (rc_t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DANG_GIAO')) AND (rc_t0.ngay_tao >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AND (rc_t0.ngay_tao < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) GROUP BY rc_t1.thanh_pho ORDER BY "revenue" ASC, "city" ASC LIMIT 5) SELECT s."period", s."store_type", SUM(s.revenue) AS "revenue" FROM scoped_rows AS s JOIN ranked_cohort AS r ON (s."city" = r."city" OR (s."city" IS NULL AND r."city" IS NULL)) GROUP BY s."period", s."store_type" ORDER BY "period" ASC NULLS LAST, "store_type" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50000
